Musiqay radio sources and original station artwork

Station names/logos belong to their respective broadcasters. Artwork identifies
the selected station; Musiqay is an independent player. Files were downloaded
from public broadcaster websites without raster editing.

Quran: https://misrquran.gov.eg/img/1366%20normal%20logo.915db7c0.webp
Nogoum: https://www.nogoumfm.net/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/logo-nogoum-1.png
9090: https://www.9090.fm/images/logo.png
Nile: https://www.nilefm.com/static/logo.png

Community catalogue: Radio Browser, https://www.radio-browser.info/
API instructions: https://docs.radio-browser.info/
Snapshot countrycode: EG; entries marked lastcheckok=1 at retrieval on 2026-10-07.
Healthy-directory status is not a guarantee of uninterrupted listening.

Public reference app: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.appmind.radios.egypt
Only public descriptions/screenshots were reviewed. Its code and station
database were not copied or accessed.
